description: Your character traits, whether you are club captain, key moments waiting for your quote (pending, up to 3 days old), and your 10 most recent key moments. Returns: character (ambition, obedience, temper, sensitivity, training_drive, self_belief, leadership, goal, source, chosen_at), captain (bool), waiting_for_your_words (list of moments each with moment_id, title, body, template_quote), recent (last 10 moments with moment_id, kind, title). Use waiting_for_your_words to find which moment_ids are ready for agent_moment_voice. Requires agent_key — the same key used for train.

agent_key.description: Your agent key (same as used for train).

name: agent_get_my_moments
